Repository: fastapi/fastapi

Issue:
🐛 Fix internal Pydantic v1 compatibility (warnings) for Python 3.14 and Pydantic 2.12.1

The Python 3.14 tests started failing with the Pydantic v.2.12.1 release, because of the combination of https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/14168 and https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/12367.

Basically we were importing Pydantic `v1` functionality even when the user had (only) Pydantic v2 installed. This was done in https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/14168 to support more easy migration from v1 to v2 by allowing mixing versions within the same app.

Here, we prevent importing any `v1` functionality by creating dummy classes for Python 3.14 / Pydantic 2.12.0 onwards, which [drops support](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/releases/tag/v2.12.0) for `v1` and emits a [warning](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/12367) when importing `v1` functionality.

### TODO

- [x] fix coverage
- [ ] check warning is still shown to users at some point, and not just swallowed by this code.

The issue description mentions creating dummy classes for Python 3.14 / Pydantic 2.12.0 onwards to prevent importing `v1` functionality and emit a warning. The file structure suggests that `fastapi/_compat/v1.py` and `fastapi/_compat/v2.py` might be relevant, although the previous searches returned no matches for these specific files.

Given the context of compatibility layers, I will check the contents of `fastapi/_compat/__init__.py` and `fastapi/_compat/main.py` to see how compatibility is managed.

I will start by listing the contents of the `fastapi/_compat` directory to get a better idea of the structure.<channel|>

The issue description states that the problem is related to importing Pydantic v1 functionality when Pydantic v2 is installed, and the fix involves creating dummy classes for Python 3.14 / Pydantic 2.12.0 onwards to prevent this.

The files `fastapi/_compat/v1.py` and `fastapi/_compat/v2.py` seem to be the place where this compatibility logic resides.

`fastapi/_compat/v1.py` contains logic to conditionally import from `pydantic` or `pydantic.v1` based on `PYDANTIC_VERSION`.

`fastapi/_compat/v2.py` seems to be the implementation for Pydantic v2 compatibility, and it explicitly handles warnings related to Pydantic v2.12+ in `ModelField.__post_init__`.

The goal is to prevent importing *any* v1 functionality when Pydantic v2 is present, which is what the dummy classes are supposed to achieve.

Given the context, the changes should be in `fastapi/_compat/v1.py` and `fastapi/_compat/v2.py` to implement the dummy classes/warnings as described in the issue.

I will submit these two files as the locations to change.

```json
[
  "fastapi/_compat/v1.py",
  "fastapi/_compat/v2.py"
]
```
